title: Primus Decision response
description: Either `answers`, one entry per question id of the request, or `error`, a one-line description of why the request could not be answered. Probabilities are aligned with the option keys of the request: for noul the keys are "false" and "true"; for choice the keys of `criteria`; for score the level indices "0" … "n-1" as strings. They sum to 1 within floating-point rounding.

noul.description: noul only: probability that the statement is true

choice.description: choice only: the option key with the largest probability

score.description: score only: the expected level, Σ level × probability
